text.en: Insulin's only job is to let glucose into cells; it has no other metabolic role -- in reality, insulin also signals the liver to store incoming glucose as glycogen rather than release its own stored glucose, and influences fat and protein metabolism as well -- its role is broader than glucose uptake into cells alone, which is only part of how it lowers blood glucose.
text.et: Insuliini ainus ülesanne on lasta glükoosil rakkudesse siseneda; sellel puudub muu ainevahetuslik roll -- tegelikult annab insuliin ka maksale signaali säilitada sissetulev glükoos glükogeenina, selle asemel et vabastada oma salvestatud glükoosi, ning mõjutab ka rasva- ja valguainevahetust -- selle roll on laiem kui pelgalt glükoosi omastamine rakkudesse, mis on vaid osa sellest, kuidas see vere glükoositaset langetab.
